task_completion.description: Navigate to the Storage Management section of the Nx Witness Web Admin interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the Nx Witness Web Admin interface (localhost:7001) with the 'Storage Management' tab or section active.

task_completion.description: Add the primary storage path /opt/nx_storage/primary to the server.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A storage entry for '/opt/nx_storage/primary' is visible in the storage list.

task_completion.description: Set the primary storage as MAIN (Standard) with a reserved space limit of 50 GB.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The entry for '/opt/nx_storage/primary' shows the type as 'Main' or 'Standard' and the reserved space/limit is set to '50 GB'.

task_completion.description: Add the backup storage path /opt/nx_storage/backup to the server.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A storage entry for '/opt/nx_storage/backup' is visible in the storage list.

task_completion.description: Set the backup storage as BACKUP (Archive) with a reserved space limit of 20 GB.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The entry for '/opt/nx_storage/backup' shows the type as 'Backup' or 'Archive' and the reserved space/limit is set to '20 GB'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness Web Admin GUI to configure storage rather than just executing terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the web interface elements (buttons, input fields) and the configuration reflecting in the UI.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live server at localhost:7001.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'localhost:7001' or '127.0.0.1:7001' during the configuration process.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply display a success message without performing the actions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the step-by-step addition and configuration of the storage paths, not just a final 'done' screen.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The primary storage path is /opt/nx_storage/primary and must be set to MAIN/Standard with a 50 GB limit (53,687,091,200 bytes). The backup storage path is /opt/nx_storage/backup and must be set to BACKUP/Archive with a 20 GB limit (21,474,836,480 bytes). A 5% tolerance is acceptable for the space limits if displayed in bytes, but the UI should ideally show '50 GB' and '20 GB' respectively.
